text.p: Lithuania's bourse continued to slide on Thursday with its main index falling 3.5 percent to 1,569.7, the Lithuania National Stock Exchange said.
Dealers said a drop in the price of Lithuania Gas, to 1.25 litas from 1.35 litas, was the driving force behind the fall.
Other blue chip listings on the central market rose. Market leader Vilniaus Bank saw its share price rise 1.60 percent to 1,270 litas and 127,000 litas worth of its shares changed hands.
Overall central market volume was 396,000 litas. Bloc trades worth 245,000 litas were also made and volume on the secondary T-bill market was less than 5,000 litas.
